prompt:
Fix snippets/trial-period-banner-2.liquid. The current file has Liquid syntax errors and does not render. Inputs (both top-level variables, always supplied): - trial_days: integer or null. The number of days left in the trial. - plan_name: string or null. The name of the plan. Behavior: - If trial_days is null, 0 or negative, output nothing (empty string). - Otherwise output exactly one element and nothing else, with no leading or trailing whitespace or newlines:

N UNIT left in your PLAN trial

- N is the value of trial_days. - UNIT is "day" when trial_days is exactly 1, otherwise "days". - PLAN is plan_name with leading and trailing whitespace removed, then HTML-escaped with the escape filter. If plan_name is null, empty, or contains only whitespace, PLAN is the literal text free. - Separate words with single spaces exactly as shown. Do not add any other markup. Examples: - trial_days 14, plan_name "Pro" ->

14 days left in your Pro trial

- trial_days 1, plan_name null ->

1 day left in your free trial

Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/trial-period-banner-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
